findings.summary: Permit-authorized convergent CAS can return ok:true without writing consume+receipt into the authority bag; kernel may substitute an ephemeral pre-CAS receipt.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Convergent permit-authorized CAS MUST co-write/verify consume+receipt in the bag or fail closed; callers MUST NOT see success with only an ephemeral receipt; add regression test.

findings.summary: inner.commit advances head before authority bag mutation with no rollback if bag write throws; orphan advanced state without consumed permit/receipt.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Failed consume/bag write MUST NOT leave committed authoritative state without consumed permit+receipt; fail closed with intact head or transactional co-commit; add failure-injection test.

findings.summary: persistJournal ignores commitJournal ok:false and continues effects/CAS without durable mid-op barriers.
findings.acceptance_criteria: commitJournal ok:false MUST block/fail closed before effects continue; add negative test for subject-not-found / journal-durability-required.
